personal.name: Alex Rivera
personal.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Rust & Svelte Specialist

summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with over 8 years of experience building high-performance distributed systems and intuitive user interfaces. Expert in **Rust (Actix)** and **Svelte**, with a deep background in **GCP** and **Kubernetes**. Passionate about enhancing **developer experience (DX)**, mentoring engineering teams, and contributing to open-source tooling. Proven track record in transitioning legacy monoliths to scalable microservices and implementing robust CI/CD pipelines.

highlights: Architected and deployed a high-throughput telemetry ingestion service using **Rust** and **Actix-web**, reducing latency by 40% compared to the previous Node.js implementation.
Led the migration of core services from on-premise to **GCP**, leveraging GKE and Cloud Spanner for global scalability.
Developed a custom internal CLI tool in Rust to streamline developer workflows, improving deployment frequency by 25%.
Mentored 4 junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, architecture workshops, and pair programming, fostering a culture of continuous learning.
Implemented comprehensive **CI/CD pipelines** using GitHub Actions and Docker, ensuring 99.9% build reliability.
Designed and built a real-time dashboard using **Svelte** and SvelteKit, providing users with instant insights into system performance.
Optimized frontend bundle sizes by 60% through advanced tree-shaking and Svelte's compile-time optimizations.
Collaborated with product designers to create a reusable UI component library, ensuring visual consistency across multiple product lines.
Integrated AWS Lambda and API Gateway to handle bursty traffic patterns for seasonal marketing campaigns.
Developed event-driven microservices using **Kotlin** and **Apache Kafka** to process millions of events per second.
Refactored a legacy Java monolith into a suite of Spring Boot services, improving maintainability and deployment velocity.
Implemented automated integration testing suites that reduced production regressions by 15%.
